method: Every Kernel prompt surface listed in prompt-inventory.json was searched for the English and Korean legacy-instruction patterns declared in the work guide (§8.2). Only confirmed matches were classified; nothing was removed on suspicion.

A_kernel_authority_kept.instruction: Do the one work unit `next` returns and stay inside its allowed paths.
The Kernel runtime executes verifications itself and owns the hard evidence.
A protected judgment is satisfied only by a review the Kernel recorded from an independent reviewer session.
Kernel completion decisions are the only completion authority.
Stay inside workUnit.allowedPaths and out of forbiddenPaths.
Do not report success. Report what you changed and what should be verified.
Do not approve a change whose acceptance has no covering evidence.
Do not claim completion. Completion is decided by the Kernel from evidence.

B_common_stable_behavior_consolidated.instruction: Complete the current work unit at its declared scope.
Make routine implementation decisions without asking.
Do not add extra planning, verification passes, reviewers, or subagents unless the Kernel action requires them.
Keep user-visible progress focused on findings, blockers, and material changes of direction.

D_provider_specific_moved.instruction: Keep thinking enabled; control cost through effort.
Use native tool calls only; do not execute tool-like text.
Effort selection per action and risk tier.
Model, reasoning effort, sandbox, and approval policy are execution authority, not prompt text.
Sol/Terra/Luna routing and reasoning effort selection.

E_dynamic_moved_to_volatile_tail.movedTo: prompt-envelope control (never rendered into a segment)
